name: SIGMA - Potential Data Exfiltration Activity Via CommandLine Tools
author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems) (original rule), Yohan Landji (Cyberlandji) (PB-02 adaptation)
description:
Detects CLI utilities exfiltrating local data via web requests - a web-request cmdlet (curl,
Invoke-WebRequest, etc.) issuing a POST whose body is sourced from a local read (Get-Content,
type, base64, recon output). Emulated as Magpie node 11 (Atomic Red Team T1041 test #1): a
powershell generates LineNumbers.txt and Invoke-WebRequest -Method POST -Body $filecontent's it
to a remote host. Sole coverage - Defender was silent. Note the atomic POSTs synthetic dummy
data to a placeholder domain (example.com), not the run's collected loot; the exfil command
pattern is fully captured here, while the confirmed network destination is one
event.category:network pivot away.
query: any where (((process.executable.caseless like~ ("*\\powershell_ise.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\cmd.exe")) and (process.command_line like~ ("*curl *", "*Invoke-RestMethod*", "*Invoke-WebRequest*", "*irm *", "*iwr *", "*wget *")) and (process.command_line:"* -ur*" and process.command_line:"* -me*" and process.command_line:"* -b*" and process.command_line:"* POST *")) or ((process.executable.caseless:"*\\curl.exe" and process.command_line:"*--ur*") and (process.command_line like~ ("* -d *", "* --data *"))) or (process.executable.caseless:"*\\wget.exe" and (process.command_line like~ ("*--post-data*", "*--post-file*")))) and ((process.command_line regex~ "net\\s+view" or process.command_line regex~ "sc\\s+query") or (process.command_line like~ ("*Get-Content*", "*GetBytes*", "*hostname*", "*ifconfig*", "*ipconfig*", "*netstat*", "*nltest*", "*qprocess*", "*systeminfo*", "*tasklist*", "*ToBase64String*", "*whoami*")) or (process.command_line:"*type *" and process.command_line:"* > *" and process.command_line:"* C:\\*"))
